intuition: Each fixed first-array value forms a sorted row of pair sums.

brute_force.approach: Generate every pair, sort by sum, and keep the first k.

optimal.approach: Seed a min-heap with the first pair from up to k rows; after removing a pair, add the next pair in that row.

edge_cases: If either array is empty or k is zero, return an empty list.
If k exceeds the number of possible pairs, return every pair.
Equal sums may be returned in any order.
